fusions.name: Eaten From Inside
fusions.desc: Bursts the nearest body within 9 tiles: it deals 28 damage plus 8% of that body's maximum health to everything within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Last Course
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. A sting that deals 18 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Passed Mouth to Mouth
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Stocked for the Brood
fusions.desc: Every kill you make stocks a cell, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per cell (20% at full). Unfed, a cell empties every 10 seconds.
